descripcion:
New bar, same wait.

Hedonic treadmill: lottery winners were not happier than controls and took less pleasure in mundane events, as adaptation-level theory predicts (Brickman, Coates & Janoff-Bulman, 1978, JPSP, PMID 690806; 22 winners and 22 controls).

NAOS · Closer to yourself. by NMR

alt: A short film with no voice. The loading screen again: the bar starts at 0 percent and climbs to 99, with the year 2026 on top and LOADING... AGAIN, calculating. The year jumps to 2031 and the estimate says after the DLC. A yellow figure with white eyes and no hands looks to the camera with narrowed eyes and a card says: Or today.
comentario_fijado: What is the next 'after' you're waiting for?
